item.title: The New Wave of Members-Only Clubs in NYC - Where To Go, What They Cost & How To Join
item.description: The New Wave of Members-Only Clubs in NYC - Where To Go, What They Cost & How To JoinMembers-Only Clubs Are Coming In StrongNew York City’s private-club scene is booming.
